criteria.name: Register match
criteria.reason: The all-caps header with concrete action verb 'REVIEW' matches the low-stakes register of LEM-009 and LEM-011, using consistent mechanics for button labels.

criteria.name: Humour boundary
criteria.reason: No humour is present, which is appropriate for low-stakes interface copy. The tone is straightforward and functional.

criteria.name: Plain language calibration
criteria.reason: The draft contains no insurance terminology to evaluate against the translation guidelines. It is straightforward button copy without specialized terms.

criteria.name: Direct address
criteria.reason: The draft uses a generic 'YOUR' rather than a named subject (e.g. pet's or person's name). The interface may or may not provide a name; since no addressee context is shown but similar approved examples (LEM-009) demonstrate personalization when available, this is scored down slightly rather than N/A because a quote screen typically has a named person or item to reference.

criteria.name: Character budget
criteria.reason: No declared character limit is provided for this interface element, so fit cannot be assessed.

criteria.name: Action verb consistency
criteria.reason: REVIEW is a concrete, established action verb consistent with other flow steps like FINALIZE PAYMENT and GET DISCOUNTS, fitting the pattern of short all-caps action buttons.

compliance.reason: The draft consists solely of the button label 'REVIEW YOUR QUOTE,' an isolated navigation/interface element in proper all-caps per mechanics. It contains no promises, no removed disclaimers, no unsupported judgement claims, no guarantees, no contradictions of known policy, and no attributed quotes or factual claims requiring a source. Per instructions, isolated navigation or button labels are not to be failed for missing surrounding context, source, or disclaimer. None of the compliance prohibitions apply to this text.
